title: LG opens K-EXAONE-2.5 API as OpenShell lands in Korea
summary: NVIDIA said LG AI Research is opening API access to K-EXAONE-2.5, trained on NVIDIA Nemotron datasets. AIM Safety is integrating OpenShell so businesses can run agents with tighter security controls.

appearances.title: OpenShell and NemoClaw move into Korean enterprise agent pilots
appearances.summary: NVIDIA says AIM Intelligence is integrating OpenShell, a sandboxed agent runtime with policy controls for data, tool access, and autonomous actions, while Hyundai Motor Group is exploring NemoClaw and OpenShell. The same update says LG AI Research is opening API access to K-EXAONE-2.5, trained on NVIDIA Nemotron datasets.
